answer: Require each agent identity to post a bond and prove a unique cipher keypair tied to sustained, independently attested work: new identities start with zero trust and earn standing only as unrelated peers attest their output over time. An attacker spinning up a plume of sock-puppet accounts faces a real cost per identity, locked stake that is slashed on fraud, while a mesa of diverse, unconnected verifiers makes coordinated fake attestation expensive and easy to spot, since puppets share funding trails and timing.
